# SkillLedger

> Last updated: 2026-03-18
> Professional skill exchange and barter platform. Professionals trade services using a credit-based system.

## What is SkillLedger?

SkillLedger is a platform for professionals to exchange skills and services without cash. Users earn credits by providing services to others, then spend credits to access services they need.

## Core Concepts

- **Skill Exchange**: Trading professional services between two or more professionals
- **Credits**: SkillLedger's internal currency. Earned by completing projects; spent on services
- **Reputation Score**: Trust metric based on completed exchanges, reviews, and platform history
- **Escrow**: Credits held until both parties confirm satisfactory project completion

## Skill Categories

Web Development, Design, Marketing, Writing & Content, Business Consulting, Video Production, Photography, Music & Audio, Data Science, AI & Machine Learning, Mobile Development, Legal Services, Finance & Accounting, Engineering, Business Development, Healthcare & Wellness, Real Estate, Non-Profit, Content Creators

## How Exchanges Work

1. Post your skills and credit rate
2. Browse professionals offering what you need
3. Propose a project with credit terms
4. Complete work; credits transfer automatically
5. Leave reviews to build reputation

## Unique Value Propositions
1. Zero transaction fees — professionals keep 100% of their earned credit value
2. Fair market value credits — rates reflect real market prices, not flat hour-for-hour
3. Built-in escrow on every exchange — credits release only when both parties confirm satisfaction
4. Automated IRS 1099-B reporting — barter tax compliance handled automatically
5. Reputation-weighted matching — badge system surfaces reliable exchange partners

## Trade Routes (/trade)

342 skill-pairing pages across 19 categories. Each page covers credit rate comparison, exchange process, FAQs, and related pairings.
- Format: /trade/[skillA]/for/[skillB]
- Example: https://skillledger.app/trade/web-development/for/design
- Example: https://skillledger.app/trade/legal/for/marketing
- Example: https://skillledger.app/trade/ai-ml/for/writing

## Location + Skill Routes (/locations)

- Format: /locations/[city]/[skill]
